hypotheses.D0_sites_reproduce_exactly: Every corpus/layer contains the same declared sites as the behavioral run.
hypotheses.D1_frozen_series_predicts_midpoint_direc: The frozen order has median cosine at least 0.95 to the explicit midpoint derivative in every cell.
hypotheses.D2_midpoint_direction_predicts_finite_en: The explicit midpoint derivative has median cosine at least 0.80 to the finite product delta in every cell.
hypotheses.D3_frozen_series_predicts_endpoint_suppo: Frozen Taylor-local top-256 support has median Jaccard at least 0.50 with endpoint-local support in every cell.
hypotheses.D4_layer0_failure_is_truncation: Moving Layer 0 from cubic to fifth order raises endpoint-local support Jaccard by at least 0.05 in both corpora.
hypotheses.D5_local_output_scoring_beats_magnitude: At frozen order, local-output scoring has at least 0.03 greater endpoint-write fidelity than magnitude scoring in every cell.
hypotheses.D6_longer_edits_reduce_behavioral_recove: Embedding chord length has Spearman correlation at most -0.20 with Taylor-local KL recovery in every cell.
hypotheses.D7_semantic_edits_are_geometrically_easi: The semantic-pair median normalized-embedding chord is at least 10% shorter than the random-token median in both corpora.
hypotheses.D8_support_overlap_predicts_behavior: Endpoint-support Jaccard has Spearman correlation at least 0.30 with Taylor-local KL recovery in every cell.
hypotheses.D9_diagnosis_does_not_refit_orders: All orders and sites come from frozen prior artifacts; the diagnostic evaluates but does not refit them.
